text: Study Figs. 4.1 and 4.2, which show information about an area of flooding in England, UK, an
The Somerset Levels is an area of low‑lying land in south west England.
From December 2013 to February 2014 the area was affected by severe
flooding causing many farms to be cut off. Homes were flooded and many
residents were evacuated as the flood water also mixed with sewage. It had
been the wettest January since records began. After the flood water went
down, a large‑scale dredging project was undertaken to remove the silt
which had been washed up the river from the Bristol Channel. A tidal barrier
